name: Non-resident foreigner: 20% flat, no unemployment insurance
source: synthetic — replace with anonymised real cases
derivation: Salary 50,000,000 for a full month; the person is a non-resident and a foreigner.
A foreign employee contributes to social and health insurance but not to unemployment insurance (the 'foreigner' exemption switches off BHTN alone).
PIT for a non-resident is a flat 20% on Vietnam-sourced salary with no deductions at all — no personal deduction, no dependants, no insurance relief: 20% x 50,000,000 = 10,000,000.
